Propose.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_ckRTkoLoAqsYl8sTnpya7453","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"content": "import { run } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call, saga } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nstructural SagaProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): SagaProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"Idempotency-Key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing Idempotency-Key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const outcome = saga([\n      {\n        name: \"reserve\",\n        run: () => call(\"inventory\", { path: \"/reserve\" }),\n        compensate: () => call(\"inventory\", { path: \"/release\" })\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"charge\",\n        run: () => call(\"billing\", { path: \"/charge\" }),\n        compensate: () => call(\"billing\", { path: \"/refund\" })\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"ship\",\n        run: () => call(\"shipping\", { path: \"/ship\" })\n      }\n    ]);\n    return Response.json(outcome);\n  });\n}\n", "file": "handler.ts"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":29248,"completion_tokens":699,"total_tokens":29947,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":29056},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":227},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":29056,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":192},"system_fingerprint":"aeb56401ca74e127821c4f9126dcb669"}
